x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change motions-technical-questions-to-officials (REQ-MTQ-001, matrix row mot-17). An agenda item type can declare a field that holds a person with an account on this instance, so a technical question can be assigned to an official who is then told.

fieldType.description: What kind of answer the field takes, which decides how it is shown and what is accepted: a single line of text, a longer text, a number, a yes/no tick, a date, a pick from the list of choices below, a link to another record, or a person with an account here (picked by name, stored as their user id).
